# Risk: [Short Title] / 风险：[简短标题]

## Identification / 识别

- **ID**: RISK-[NNNN]
- **Identified By**: [Agent or person / 识别人]
- **Date Identified**: [Date / 日期]
- **Category**: [Technical | Design | Schedule | Resource | External | Quality / 技术 | 设计 | 进度 | 资源 | 外部 | 质量]

## Assessment / 评估

- **Probability**: [Very Low | Low | Medium | High | Very High / 非常低 | 低 | 中等 | 高 | 非常高]
- **Impact**: [Minimal | Minor | Moderate | Major | Critical / 轻微 | 较小 | 中等 | 重大 | 关键]
- **Risk Score**: [Probability x Impact = Low / Medium / High / Critical / 可能性 × 影响 = 低 / 中等 / 高 / 关键]

## Description / 描述

[Detailed description of the risk. What could go wrong? Under what conditions? / 风险的详细描述。可能出现什么问题？在什么条件下？]

## Trigger Conditions / 触发条件

[What observable conditions would indicate this risk is materializing? / 哪些可观察到的条件表明此风险正在发生？]

- [Condition 1 / 条件1]
- [Condition 2 / 条件2]

## Impact Analysis / 影响分析

### If This Risk Materializes / 如果此风险发生

- **Schedule Impact**: [How many days/weeks of delay / 延迟多少天/周]
- **Quality Impact**: [What quality degradation / 质量下降情况]
- **Scope Impact**: [What features affected / 受影响的功能]
- **Cost Impact**: [Resource cost of dealing with it / 处理此风险的资源成本]

### Affected Systems/Features / 受影响的系统/功能

- [System 1 / 系统1]
- [System 2 / 系统2]

## Mitigation Strategy / 缓解策略

### Prevention (reduce probability) / 预防（降低可能性）

- [Action to prevent this risk from occurring / 防止此风险发生的行动]
- [Owner and deadline for prevention action / 预防行动负责人和截止日期]

### Contingency (reduce impact if it occurs) / 应急计划（如果发生则减少影响）

- [Action to take if this risk materializes / 如果此风险发生应采取的行动]
- [Owner responsible for contingency execution / 应急执行负责人]

## Current Status / 当前状态

- **Status**: [Open | Mitigating | Occurred | Closed / 开放 | 缓解中 | 已发生 | 已关闭]
- **Last Reviewed**: [Date / 日期]
- **Trend**: [Increasing | Stable | Decreasing / 上升 | 稳定 | 下降]
- **Notes**: [Any updates / 任何更新]
